## What is a dedicated desk in ADGM?

A dedicated desk in ADGM is a permanent, personally assigned desk inside an Abu Dhabi Global Market business centre that comes with a registered ADGM business address and a lease you can use for your ADGM licence. Unlike a flexi desk, it is yours every day, and it is usually the lowest-cost workspace that satisfies ADGM's physical-presence requirement.

## Included with every dedicated desk

- Your own permanent desk: The same furnished desk every day — leave your screen, files and setup in place.
- Registered ADGM business address: Use it for your ADGM licence application and renewals.
- ADGM-compliant lease: A lease registered on AccessRP, accepted for ADGM company registration.
- 24/7 access & lockable storage: Secure, round-the-clock access to Addax Tower and your desk.
- Meeting rooms & lounge: Meeting room access and the business lounge for client calls.
- Everything serviced: High-speed WiFi, coffee, print & scan, cleaning and reception included.

## From desk to ADGM licence

1. Reserve your desk — Book a tour or a WhatsApp video walkthrough and choose your desk on the 38th floor.
2. Due diligence — Quick KYC checks required by ADGM — a one-time AED 1,200 fee.
3. Lease on AccessRP — We issue your ADGM-compliant dedicated desk lease and register it on AccessRP.
4. Licence & move in — Use your registered ADGM business address for the licence, then collect your access card.

## Frequently asked questions

### How much is a dedicated desk in ADGM?

A dedicated desk at Aegis Coworking in Addax Tower is AED 1,150 per month — only AED 150 more than a flexi desk at AED 1,000. A one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee applies, and ADGM government fees are charged separately. There is no deposit, no admin fee and no setup fee.

### What is the difference between a dedicated desk and a flexi desk in ADGM?

A dedicated desk is your own permanent desk with a registered ADGM business address for your licence, 24/7 access and lockable storage. A flexi desk (hot desk) lets you use any open desk for AED 1,000 per month and suits individuals or companies without an ADGM licensing requirement.

### Does the dedicated desk satisfy the ADGM flexi desk requirement?

Yes. The Aegis dedicated desk qualifies as an ADGM flexi desk, meeting the physical presence and registered address requirement for your ADGM business licence application.

### Can I register my ADGM company with a dedicated desk?

Yes. The dedicated desk includes a registered ADGM business address and an ADGM-compliant lease registered on AccessRP, which you can use for your ADGM licence application and renewals.

Read more:

### Is a dedicated desk enough for a solo business in ADGM?

For most solo founders and consultants, yes. A dedicated desk gives you the registered address and physical presence ADGM looks for, at a fraction of the cost of a private office. Firms regulated by the FSRA usually need a private office instead.

### Can I get employee visas with a dedicated desk in ADGM?

Visa capacity in ADGM depends on your workspace type and licence. A dedicated desk can support visa applications; the number allowed is set by ADGM rules, so check your plan with us before hiring.

### What is the cheapest desk in ADGM at Aegis?

The cheapest desk at Aegis is the day pass at AED 100 for a 9 AM–6 PM workday. For monthly use, the flexi desk is AED 1,000. If you need a desk for an ADGM licence, the dedicated desk at AED 1,150 is the lowest-cost option that includes a registered ADGM business address.

### What is included in the AED 1,200 due-diligence fee?

It covers the compliance and background checks ADGM requires before your licence and registered address can be activated. It is a one-time cost, separate from your monthly desk rent.

### How long is the dedicated desk lease?

Dedicated desk leases run from 12 to 36 months. You can upgrade to a private office at any time as your team grows.

### Do I get 24/7 access with a dedicated desk?

Yes. Dedicated desk members have secure 24/7 access to Addax Tower and their desk, every day of the week.

### Can two companies use the same dedicated desk address?

Each ADGM company needs its own qualifying workspace and registered address arrangement. Ask us about setups for more than one company.

Many members use their dedicated desk as the company's registered ADGM address and physical base while working flexibly. Your licence obligations still apply, so read our guide first.
